verdict.rationale: Modal Sandboxes are designed to be created and driven without a UI. Official Python, JS and Go SDKs create sandboxes, exec commands and tail logs from code, and an official CLI can run commands in containers, so headless automation is core to the product. A community builder also ran GitHub Actions self-hosted runners on Modal Sandboxes, which corroborates CI-style use. missing for 10: explicit docs on non-interactive or CI authentication (e.g. token env vars), a first-party CI integration guide for invoking sandboxes from pipelines.
